Name: Overgrown Skeletons and Pink Monsters
Author: boringvlln
Description:
[size=3]Ever felt like the monsters in the Valley could use an overhaul to fit in with the pastel, bright and cute aesthetic? If so, here is a solution for that![/size]

[size=3]This mod consists of [/size][u][s]53[/s] [s]55[/s] 57 (!) retextures[/u][size=3], covering the majority of the monsters (yes, including the dangerous types too). It does not cover slimes, because there are already: [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6073]Cuter Slimes[/url][size=3], [/size][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-11#post-3277759]Slime cute kitty cat retexture[/url][size=3], and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7912]Kitty Tiger Slimes[/url][size=3].[/size]
[size=1]It also does not cover crabs, because they have to blend in with the enviroment better (and are they even monsters anyway?)
[/size][url=https://boosty.to/btwleo]
[/url]

Some of sprites have undergone more changes, some less. There are changes in colors, added/reshaped details. I have added several before/after pictures to the images section, as well as an overview file with all of the new sprites, placed alphabetically. The overview file is included in the download: it is not required for the mod to run, but it can help you with configuration.

The mod is fully [b]customizable[/b]: after you launch the game with this mod for the first time, it will generate a config file. You can individually disable/enable changes to each and every monster. Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

For a different take on Shadow Brutes check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15952]Shadow People Wear Familiar Faces[/url]. Don't forget to disable them in config here, if you use both mods.
